body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Toshiba introduced its new model of Blu-ray players 'BDX2700' at CES 2010, packed with built-in wireless connectivity.

It features 1080p/24fps playback of Blu-ray titles, as well as upconversion of standard definition DVD, BD-Live capable, offer online streaming capability, playback of MP3, HD-JPEG, WMA and AVCHD for home movie viewing. It will have a suggested price of $249.99 and become available in spring 2010.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
